title: MIXED REVIEW
text:
MIXED REVIEW. I ordered both the Winter Berry AND the Fraser Fir. I like that they are a soy blend.
The Winter Berry is a COMPLETE DELIGHT! It smells wonderful in the box and also while burning.
The Fraser Fir smells great in the box, but once it is lit there is NO FRAGRANCE! I just ordered some scented oil to drop on the Fraser Fir to get the desired scent. Very disappointing!
Bottom line: I highly recommend the Winter Berry, but the Fraser Fir is a waste of $.
